authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3865 subsection 2 khādita explicitly gives Nepali khāyo and Hindi khāyā ate. The Dotyali khāyo drinking responses, including a survey record glossed eat; drink, continue that past-stem branch. Platts 868 independently confirms drink as a meaning of the consume verb. The original survey meaning and transcription are preserved. Exact response: kʰāyo.
